sources.title: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
sources.snippet: Apache ActiveMQ: The Fileserver web application in Apache ActiveMQ allows remote attackers to upload and execute arbitrary files via an HTTP PUT followed by an HTTP MOVE request Required action: Apply updates per vendor instructions.
supports: CISA KEV identifies CVE-2016-3088 as exploited in the wild.

sources.title: CVE-2016-6810: NVD vulnerability record
sources.snippet: In Apache ActiveMQ 5.x before 5.14.2, an instance of a cross-site scripting vulnerability was identified to be present in the web based administration console. The root cause of this issue is improper user data output validation.
supports: Web-cited CVE-2016-6810 was retrieved independently from NVD; applicability and exploitation are unverified.

sources.title: CVE-2010-0684: NVD vulnerability record
sources.snippet: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in createDestination.action in Apache ActiveMQ before 5.3.1 allows remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the JMSDestination parameter in a queue action.
supports: NVD lists CVE-2010-0684 as a research lead; product identity, version applicability, and exploitation remain unverified.

sources.title: CVE-2010-1244: NVD vulnerability record
sources.snippet: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in createDestination.action in Apache ActiveMQ before 5.3.1 allows remote attackers to hijack the authentication of unspecified victims for requests that create queues via the JMSDestination parameter in a queue action.
supports: NVD lists CVE-2010-1244 as a research lead; product identity, version applicability, and exploitation remain unverified.

DescriptionThe version of Apache ActiveMQ running on the remote host is 5.x prior to 5.14.2. sources.snippet: UNTRUSTED WEB RESEARCH (not PCAP evidence). CVE-2026-34197 is a remote code execution vulnerability in Apache ActiveMQ Classic that has been hiding in plain sight for 13 years.

sources.title: Critical Vulnerability in Apache ActiveMQ Classic
sources.snippet: UNTRUSTED WEB RESEARCH (not PCAP evidence). Background. Apache has released security updates to address a code injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-34197) affecting Apache ActiveMQ Classic. | Webpage text: [PARTIAL WEBPAGE: only first 150000 bytes examined] Critical Vulnerability in Apache ActiveMQ Classic Critical Vulnerability in Apache ActiveMQ Classic Apache has released security updates to address a critical vulnerability in Apache ActiveMQ Classic. Users and administrators of affected products are advised to update to the latest versions immediately. Apache has released security updates to address a code injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-34197) affecting Apache ActiveMQ Classic. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an authenticated attacker to perform arbitrary code execution on the affected system. On versions 6.0.0 through 6.1.1, when chained with CVE-2024-32114, the vulnerability can be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker, potentially resulting in full compromise of the affected system. This vulnerability affects the following Apache ActiveMQ Classic versions: - Apache ActiveMQ versions prior to 5.19.4 - Apache ActiveMQ versions 6.0.0 through 6.2.2 - Apache ActiveMQ Broker versions prior to 5.19.4 - Apache ActiveMQ Broker versions 6.0.0 through 6.2.2 Users and administrators of affected products are advised to update to the latest versions immediately. https://activemq.apache.org/security-advisories.data/CVE-2026-34197-announcement.txt (opens in new tab) https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-34197 (opens in new tab) https://horizon3.ai/attack-research/disclosures/cve-2026-34197-activemq-rce-jolokia/ (opens in new tab)

This issue affects Apache Log4j before 2. Affected users are recommended to update to Log4j 2.x. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. CVE-2022-22971 In spring framework versions prior to 5.3.20+ , 5.2.22+ and old unsupported versions, application with a STOMP over WebSocket endpoint is vulnerable to a denial of service attack by an authenticated user.
